day_shape: 51 items: Iranian container ship struck in Strait of Hormuz kills one with four injured, Defa Press and IRIB claim Yemeni attack on Prince Khalid Air Base, IDF names two Hamas engineers killed in Gaza City strike, heavy regime messaging on 12-day war court hearings; nothing from UK Parliament or OFAC.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz ship strike and corridor talks
threads.summary: An Iranian container ship was struck by an unidentified projectile near Qeshm, killing one crew member and injuring four according to Iran International, with IRIB citing the Qeshm governor putting casualties at four. Foreign Minister Araghchi said an Oman meeting will address a new sea lane but ruled out reopening the Strait pending US return to the Islamabad Memorandum.

threads.label: Yemen strikes and Saudi response claims
threads.summary: Defa Press and IRIB claimed Yemeni forces struck Prince Khalid Air Base in Khamis Mushait and oil tanks at Yanbu, while Defa Press cited Israel Hayom saying Mohammed bin Salman requested Israeli intelligence support via Washington against Yemen. Yemen's Deputy Foreign Minister told UN envoy Hans Grundberg that Sanaa is ready for 'just peace'.

threads.label: IDF Gaza strikes and ceasefire fallout
threads.summary: The IDF named Hassan Ali Abu Nada and Abd al-Rahim Ahmad Khalil Khawa, two Hamas engineering-unit operatives, as killed in a Gaza City airstrike, with a separate vehicle strike killing two Palestinians and wounding 13. Jerusalem Post cited Kushner in Kyiv calling the IDF Doha strike 'unsuccessful as a military operation' but useful for pushing Israel toward a Gaza deal.

threads.label: 12-day war aftermath and Iranian rearmament reporting
threads.summary: Defa Press reported the first hearing of a court case brought by families of '12-day war' martyrs, while the acting Defence Minister said Iran would fight 'more powerfully' in any future war. Jerusalem Post cited the Financial Times reporting Tehran asked Moscow for new-generation Geran drones during the Israeli-US war, and CNN reporting Hegseth pressured downed US pilots to appear on 60 Minutes.

threads.label: Iran domestic: executions, economy, banking discipline
threads.summary: HRANA reported at least eight women face execution in Iran and a January-protest detainee in Shandiz was sentenced to death, while Iran International described shoppers buying bread on credit and queueing for chicken scraps. Iran's Central Bank ordered disciplinary action against 11 branch heads and fined 10 banks over forex and precious-metals misuse.

Russia's permanent representative to the OSCE said in this regard: Russia has repeatedly emphasised Europe's security crisis and the necessity of addressing its roots and has pointed to the severe deterioration of the military-political situation in Europe and the collapse of the previous security structure.

events.title_en: Frame of Life: narratives from the life of the Supreme Leader of the Revolution. Prayer in secluded tents. Commander Ali Fazli, a veteran commander of the Sacred Defence, speaks about the presence of Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Khamenei in the Martyrs' Leader Corps
events.summary_en: Frame of Life: narratives from the life of the Supreme Leader of the Revolution. Prayer in secluded tents. Commander Ali Fazli, a veteran commander of the Sacred Defence, speaks about the presence of Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Khamenei in the Martyrs' Leader Corps: His Excellency always considered going back and forth to the front lines as part of their principles and criteria. Regarding prayer, he tried to perform his prayers in places where there was no congregation, in secluded and dark areas where fewer people were present. There were many tents there, but His Excellency would choose scattered and distant tents for prayer and supplication. This was repeated throughout the period he spent in the Corps and was his constant practice.

events.title_en: New criminal guarantee; a brake on escaping debt. Head of parliamentary judicial committee:
events.summary_en: New criminal guarantee; a brake on escaping debt. Head of parliamentary judicial committee: The main concern of creditors is that the debtor transfers their assets to others' names when the debt is claimed. With effective criminal enforcement guarantee, transactions intended to escape debt have significantly decreased. The verification network places all debtor assets at the court's disposal up to one year before the creditor's lawsuit. With this system, the possibility of having assets and not paying debts is greatly reduced.

events.summary_en: Commander Ibn al-Reza: in the next battle we will fight more powerfully. The acting Defence Minister, speaking to defence industry officials, said: with very high confidence I say if another war breaks out today, the Islamic Republic of Iran will operate much more powerfully and advanced from a technological standpoint than in previous wars. Those who try to portray the continuation of technological activities and production lines and weapons factories of the country merely as a narrative or media headline have seen well on the ground the capabilities of our armed forces. What is sometimes presented is a small part of the actual capacity and potential in the country's defence industry and this path continues with full force.

events.title: Two Hamas engineers were killed in an Israeli airstrike in Gaza City today, the military announces. The IDF names the pair as Hassan Ali Abu Nada and Abd al-Rahim Ahmad Khalil Khawa, operatives in Hamas's engineering unit. Recently, the two terror operatives were involved in development and production of weapons, advancing attacks on troops and civilians, and also attempted to restore Hamas capabilities, "in systematic violation of the ceasefire," the military says. "The terrorists were eliminated to remove a threat," the army says, adding that it took steps to minimize harm to civilians in the strike.

events.title_en: Ansarullah: Trump has been forced to acknowledge Yemen's independence and important status
events.summary_en: Ansarullah: Trump has been forced to acknowledge Yemen's independence and important status. Mohammad al-Farah viewed Trump's contradictory statements about Yemen as meaning his explicit acknowledgement of Yemen's independence and important status. Trump's statements at each stage differ from his previous statements and he does not adopt a fixed position, but these very contradictions ultimately reveal a fundamental truth about Yemen. Trump's statements can be interpreted from two different angles, both of which lead to one conclusion. If Trump is telling the truth in his statements, it demonstrates an acknowledgement that Yemen has its own independent decision-making capability and does not act as a representative or agent of any external party, and if he is lying...

events.title: Iranians buy bread on credit, queue for chicken scraps
events.summary: Iranians are increasingly buying basic food on credit and lining up for chicken scraps, with shopkeepers and residents describing shrinking purchasing power under rapidly rising prices in a report published Sunday.

events.title: Iran students go without as elite schools charge billions
events.summary: Some Iranian schools are charging billions of rials for pools, therapy and small classes as students elsewhere reuse old bags and go without uniforms, shoes and stationery because their families cannot afford them ahead of the new school year.
